note: Both sets share the same core section, elevation, and title-block claims, and both misread the finished floor as 2' 3 1/2" (the sheet reads 2' - 9 1/2"). Set A additionally captures useful room-bound facts (Bedroom and Kitchen finished floor and grade elevations) that are supported by the section drawings, while Set B omits them. Set B instead adds a spurious 'dimension | length | 6 ft' claim taken from a scale-bar tick, which is not a dimension of any component. Set A's extra claims are mostly redundant duplicates rather than errors, so it is the more complete and faithful set.
